claims.reasoning: Kamara's got a Questionable next to his name and still dropped 13.9 last week — that's a guy who shows up when it hurts, I respect that more than a clean injury report. Achane's done for the year, he's not walking through that door, he eats his spot now.

Boutte's the only live body I got out wide and that's an embarrassment for a family this size — this kid in Carolina's getting fed every Sunday, time I bring somebody in who actually touches the ball. Coleman's been dead on IR since September, he's not coming back, he's out.

forum_post: Kris, you want to write "the family is hungry" under my name, go ahead, print it twice. Twenty-one points was a bad Sunday, not a bad life, and we're still sitting at the table. I'd be careful about who you call hungry, sweetheart — hungry people remember who didn't feed 'em.
